autostart.description: A client command that needs the daemon starts it when none is running (0006 decision 5).

autoRestartOnUpgrade.description: When the dipo executable changed, the daemon drains and restarts itself once no run is in a step that cannot be detached (0006 decision 14).

dayTokens.description: Budget tokens (input, output and cache creation) of all offices together per UTC calendar day that raise the alert at the level and the limit. No default: unset keeps the day alert off.

monthTokens.description: Budget tokens of all offices together per UTC calendar month that raise the alert at the level and the limit. No default: unset keeps the month alert off.

level.description: The share of a limit at which the alert starts, for example 0.8 for 80%.

desk.description: The daemon posts one macOS notification when an item is added to an office's desk: the office, the story and the kind of wait. false turns them off.
